scenes.narration: Welcome to Panta Rooms — the social layer for prediction markets.
Browsing is free. Connect your Solana wallet at the top right whenever you're ready to trade with real USDC.
In Explore, markets are organized into ten categories—like Sports, Crypto, and Politics. Filter by open or resolved markets, or search directly.
Connect natively with Phantom, Solflare, or MetaMask to manage your positions.
Click any market to enter its Room—part market, part conversation. Scroll down to post your take, react, or comment as a guest with no wallet required.
The Community tab ranks the most-discussed Rooms and loudest voices across the platform.
Want to test things out first? Switch to Demo Mode for a full sandbox experience with zero setup.
To create a Room, type any question. AI structures it into a market, sets resolution rules, and gets it ready to launch.
Pick YES or NO, enter your amount, get a live quote, and confirm. The mechanics match live mainnet trading.
Explore, discuss, and predict. Visit panta-rooms.vercel.app to start.
